health_review (after observe_ecosystem, [standing]) ->
overseer-health-review.yaml via recipe-runner-rs
AGENT reads OODA journal (journalctl --user -u <unit>)
+ simard status + simard goal list; detects crash-loops /
shared failure signatures; reasons to gated LaunchRecipe /
EscalateBlockedGoal (HEALTHY verdict = empty = no-op).
Fail-closed. Gated by health_review_enabled + gap_scan throttle
